# Rock: a jittered, flattened icosphere. Up Z.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.45 --location 0 0 0.18
scale 1.0 0.8 0.6
apply --scale
material new Stone --base-color 0.545 0.427 0.612
active Rock
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.07 --seed 9
mode object
shade flat
export rock.glb
